clips.title: The story
paras: The tauren, or shu'halo in their native tongue, are a noble race of nomadic bovine humanoids native to central Kalimdor. Deeply devoted to the Earth Mother, shamanism, and the natural world, they were driven near extinction by ruthless centaur clans before forging a bond with Thrall's New Horde. Today, united under High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, they have established a permanent home across the verdant plains of Mulgore and the high rises of Thunder Bluff.

For countless generations, the tauren lived as seasonal nomads wandering the arid plains of the Barrens, hunting the great kodo and listening for the voice of the Earth Mother. However, their peaceful wanderings were plagued by centuries of brutal bloodshed. The ferocious centaur tribes, born from the tragic union of Zaetar and Princess Theradras, waged an unrelenting war of extermination against them. Lacking a fortified homeland and reluctant to wage endless war, the tauren tribes were pushed to the brink of annihilation, their very survival hanging by a thread.
